pay.cashHow.text: Pay this reference in cash at a participating store, such as OXXO.

pay.speiHow.text: Make a SPEI transfer to the account below, using the concept shown.

consequence.expireBooking.text: If it is not paid by then, the booking expires.

consequence.cancelJobRefundDeposit.text: If it is not paid by then, the job is cancelled and the deposit is refunded.

consequence.expireRequest.text: If it is not paid by then, the request expires.

demo.simulatePayment.text: Demo: mark this payment as received

payment.expiredBody.text: The booking expired because the payment was not made in time. You can start a new request.

refund.clabeIntro.text: You paid in cash or by transfer, so we need an account to send the refund to.

pay.processing.text: Processing your payment. Don't close this page.

pay.network.text: We couldn't finish your payment. Nothing was charged. Try again.

pay.unknown.text: We're not sure your payment went through. Don't pay again yet. We'll confirm in a few minutes.

pay.refFailed.text: We couldn't create your payment reference. Try again.

refund.clabeRejected.text: Your bank didn't accept this CLABE. Check it with your bank and try again.

refund.autoFailed.text: We couldn't start your refund. Try again, or contact support.

refund.clabeInvalid.text: A CLABE has 18 digits. Check it and try again.

refund.done.text: Refund issued. It should arrive by {date}.

refund.original.text: Your refund goes back to your original payment method. It should arrive by {date}.

request.emergencyAfterHours.text: It is outside Agent hours. The Assistant and automatic matching will handle your urgent request, and an Agent will follow up on the next support day.
